== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[With Thunderous Applause (Virtual Block 5) (Errata 2)]] (<code>1250_22</code>, Virtual Block 5 slip 25), showing the '''PC-E2''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 5 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-25-With_Thunderous_Applause.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-D-withthunderousapplause-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[With Thunderous Applause (Virtual Block 5)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee Virtual Cards [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Master List (Dark Side)], official text as of 27 April 2013 (Internet Archive). Icons are drawn as on the printed slip.
* '''PC-E2 text:''' “Deploy on Sidious. At start of your turn, if at Senate, may draw 2 cards from Reserve Deck. During your move phase, relocate this Effect to a Rebel or Jedi at a battleground; that character loses any immunity to attrition. If this Effect just lost, relocate it to Sidious.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1005_L6764</code> (printed frame, Decipher art <code>12_162</code>, title, lore, icons, slip number, Virtual Block 5 set mark) with the PC-E2 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
